items.title: December 1 Is Officially A Big Day For Xbox Game Pass
items.summary: Two big games are arriving on Xbox Game Pass on December 1, with half a dozen more slated to join the membership service before then.
items.content:
December 1 Is Officially A Big Day For Xbox Game Pass From Screen Rant (Written by Yuliya Geikhman) on November 23, 2026 | OpenCritic

Big things are coming to the Xbox Game Pass on December 1, when two great games join the games catalog for members. If that's not enough, several more exciting titles are scheduled for addition to the Game Pass.

These games join the growing list of 900 titles that are included in the members' library. New games are added frequently, including day-one releases. That's the case on December 1, when one tiny mouse goes on a big adventure with a day-one release joining the catalog.

On December 1, Hela: of Mice & Magic will become available as a day-one release for Xbox Series X|S, PC, and cloud gaming for Xbox Game Pass subscribers, according to Xbox . Hela follows a small mouse on a cooperative quest through a vast landscape inspired by Northern Sweden. The title was developed by Windup—the makers of Unravel —and features a story about the triumph and beauty of nature and kindness.

Also arriving on December 1 is The Outlast Trials, Red Barrels' highly rated 2023 co-op survival horror game. You and a group of friends can play through Cold War-era therapy that consists of good-old-fashioned brainwashing and mind control. Survive through a series of challenges...

items.title: Xbox Game Pass November wave 2 adds Hela, The Outlast Trials, Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2
Game Pass adds The Outlast Trials and Hela, but one tier gets left out
items.summary: Xbox Game Pass subscribers have an unusual double bill coming on December 1: the cooperative horror of The Outlast Trials and the gentler mouse adventure
items.content:
This article needs JavaScript to display. Please turn on JavaScript in your browser and reload the page. Xbox Game Pass subscribers have an unusual double bill coming on December 1: the cooperative horror of The Outlast Trials and the gentler mouse adventure Hela: of Mice & Magic . Both are heading to console, PC and cloud, but there is a subscription detail worth checking before you make plans.

The Outlast Trials will join Ultimate, Premium and PC Game Pass. Hela is a day-one addition for Ultimate and PC Game Pass, and Microsoft's announcement does not list Premium for that game.

The new wave also brings High on Life 2 , Motorslice and Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 to more subscribers. Several games are leaving on November 30, so there is also a useful deadline if you have been meaning to finish one.

Hela follows a mouse through landscapes inspired by northern Sweden. Image: Windup / Knights Peak / Steam

According to Xbox's announcement , Call of the Elder Gods , High on Life 2 and the Game Preview release Roadside Research join Ultimate and PC Game Pass on November 18. All three were already included with Premium, so this is an expansion to those other plans rather than a completely new arrival for every subscriber.

The same pattern applies to Black Jacket on November 19 and Motorslice on November 24. Also on November 24, Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 arrives for Ultimate, Premium and PC Game Pass.

On November 27, team-based action game Arkheron enters Game Preview as a day-one addition for Ultimate and PC Game Pass. Game Preview means it is still in development, something to keep in mind if you prefer waiting for a finished release.

Hela will join Game Pass on its release date. Image: Windup / Knights Peak / Steam

The Outlast Trials puts players through disturbing experiments and can be played alone or with friends. Hela takes a less terrifying route, sending a small mouse into a world inspired by northern Sweden to explore and solve puzzles.

The distinction between subscription tiers is easy to miss. Xbox lists both games for cloud, Xbox Series X|S and PC, but the available plan differs. Check your own plan and preferred device before counting either game as part of your subscription.

If you are considering Ultimate, Amazon lists a three-month US digital Game Pass Ultimate code . Check the region and redemption terms first; existing subscribers do not need to buy another code just to access games in their plan.

The adventure supports cooperative play. Image: Windup / Knights Peak / Steam

The departing list includes Aliens: Dark Descent , Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden , Generation Zero , Kill It With Fire! 2 , Moving Out 2 , Star Trucker , Totally Reliable Delivery Service and DreamWorks Gabby's Dollhouse: Ready to Party .

That gives you a little time to decide which is worth returning to. The lineup follows the earlier November Game Pass additions , which included Warhammer Survivors and Thronefall .

items.summary: Gather around, gamers! We’ve got more games coming your way, and there’s a little something for everyone. In the mood for a little magic? Terrifying Gather around, gamers! We’ve got more games coming your way. Hela: of Mice & Magic, The Outlast Trials, Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2, and more coming soon to Game Pass!
items.content:
Gather around, gamers! We’ve got more games coming your way, and there’s a little something for everyone. In the mood for a little magic? Terrifying trials? High-stakes sniper missions? We’ve got it all. So, let’s get right into the games!

Paw Patrol: Dino World (Cloud, Console, and PC) Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, PC Game Pass

Embark on a dino-sized action adventure in Paw Patrol Dino World ! Explore Dino Island, rescue dinosaurs, overcome obstacles using the Pups’ unique skills and put a stop to Mayor Humdinger’s chaos. Take on the adventure solo or team up with a friend in two-player co-op.

Call of the Elder Gods (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 18 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea .

High on Life 2 (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 18 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through exotic locales across the galaxy to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

Roadside Research (Game Preview) (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 18 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

Aliens have landed on Earth… to run a gas station. Play solo or up to 4 players doing human tasks to blend in. Scan, steal, and test various methods on customers while they stop by the gas station. Gather all data you can from humans without raising the suspicion meter too high, risk a visit from government officials.

Black Jacket (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 19 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

21 or eternity? Black Jacket drops you into a purgatorial card game where restless souls wager their coins, and the ferryman waits for his cut. From Mi’pu’mi Games and Skystone Games ( Tiny Bookshop ) — a painterly, pitch-black spin on blackjack awaits. Cheating fully encouraged.

Motorslice (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 24 Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass

Play as the skilled (but seemingly ever-sleepy) slicer, P, and parkour through the ruins of a brutalist megastructure, climb massive bosses, and hunt down every piece of living construction equipment in this slice of life action-adventure with immaculate vibes.

Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 (Cloud, Console, Handheld, and PC) – November 24 Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, PC Game Pass

items.title: The Outlast Trials – Anything but Torture Review
items.summary: I have seen and done horrible things in The Outlast Trials. I’ve had to saw a man’s legs off at a recreation of the Last Supper, I’ve electrocuted a police informant, and I’ve melted a politician all the way down to the bone. But, while you might say “Jeez,” it’s all a part of the messy fun, as the game is willing to go the extra mile to keep you on your feet, whether you’re screaming or laughing all the way. The Outlast Trials begins with your character down on their luck—no home, job, or reason to persevere. To escape this state of affairs, you volunteered for rehabilitation under the Murkoff Corporation. What you didn’t sign up for was being subjected to lethal trials within labyrinthian gauntlets.
items.content:
November 2, 2026 Entertainment , Spotlight , Top Headlines , Topstory Leave a comment 637 Views

I have seen and done horrible things in The Outlast Trials. I’ve had to saw a man’s legs off at a recreation of the Last Supper, I’ve electrocuted a police informant, and I’ve melted a politician all the way down to the bone. But, while you might say “Jeez,” it’s all a part of the messy fun, as the game is willing to go the extra mile to keep you on your feet, whether you’re screaming or laughing all the way.

The Outlast Trials begins with your character down on their luck—no home, job, or reason to persevere. To escape this state of affairs, you volunteered for rehabilitation under the Murkoff Corporation. What you didn’t sign up for was being subjected to lethal trials within labyrinthian gauntlets.

Each map is a makeshift location full of psychos and murderers lurking about. Every session requires you to enter the premises, complete objectives, then evacuate. How hard this will be depends on how quiet and vigilant you are, which affects your score at the end as well as your rewards.

For the most part, The Outlast Trials adopts the series’ stealth-horror structure, but here, it’s at its peak. You don’t want to draw attention, so it pays to watch for hazards like broken glass on the floor or traps. Then again, you must move with a sense of urgency.

What’s interesting is how you can use the dark as camouflage since most enemies don’t have night-vision. You could practically be standing next to them without triggering them, which is very useful and oftentimes hilarious.

Another interesting mechanic is psychosis, which is caused by inhaling dangerous gas if you fall into specific traps or encounter an enemy called the Pusher. You’ll be left scrambling for an antidote while hallucinations like tentacles and menacing figures cause you real damage, leading to you exposing yourself to real enemies if you have to move from your hiding spot.

Like its predecessors, you can’t fight in The Outlast Trials, but you can evade your pursuers and slow them down. Every map grants a slew of feats for avoiding enemies if you’re spotted. You could slide through an open vent, hide in places like a large toybox or a cabinet, or throw a bottle at an enemy to stun them.

Then, there’s your rig that allows one of six special abilities , like being able to barricade a doorway or disable electronics. They improve with upgrades, but I was confused about why their upgrades had to be consecutively unlocked. One of the final upgrades for each rig reduces its cooldown timer, so having an ability at your convenience will take some investing.

Helping the gameplay is how the map has a unique aesthetic with a dose of social commentary. The narrative behind everything might not be up front, but who needs exposition when you’ve got bucketloads of style?

Take the fun park, for example. Tasks sometimes resemble carnival games, but the entire attraction feels like something from Universal Studios’ Halloween Horror Nights. However, the map is also poking a spear at the spoiled rotten members of society who think they’re entitled to everything.

The level of disturbing horror is nailed thanks to how gruesome and crude the game presents itself. There is excessive gore, torture, sexual debauchery, and graphic nudity–sometimes all at once.

All of the maps’ strengths alleviate how similar the chapters’ objectives might be. Dumping evidence files into a grinder at the police station functions the same as placing expensive boxes at a checkout area in the mall, but the atmosphere covers it up.

Of course, it’s not an Outlast game without psychopaths. The Outlast Trials has its own motley crew of stone-cold killers. Mother Gooseberry is exceptionally terrifying with her duck hand-puppet equipped with a built-in drill, but I also loved how Liliya camouflages with mannequins on her associated map and hides inside of hiding spots to throw you a curveball. Every enemy will handle you differently, and it’s best you stay out of their path before things get messy.

items.title: The Outlast Trials Is An Exercise In Bad Taste And Good Politics
items.summary: This multiplayer prequel is as gruesome as it is relevant
items.content:
Halloween Horror Spooky Week 2026 The Outlast Trials

In Rex Miller’s 1987 horror novel Slob , Chicago is under the blight of “Chaingang,” a 500-pound killer whose hunger for food and flesh is unequaled. Despite his appearance and more odorous stench, the walking death manages to maneuver with little detection due to what’s described as an uncanny charisma. He is effectively camouflaged. Such an unusual make of man, it turns out, is not born. Chaingang was designed by the Pentagon, part of a covert project to create an unstoppable murder machine to turn the tide in Vietnam. A Michael Myers for Uncle Sam.

The Outlast Trials is entirely consumed by this boomerang paradigm. In the co-op game, you and other lower rungs of society are subjected to mental conditioning tests. Solve puzzles, elude enemy detection and, occasionally, murder in unthinkable ways. A multiplayer prequel to Red Barrel’s hit 2013 survival horror Outlast in which a citizen journalist discovers a creepy mental asylum providing cover for a backfiring supersoldier program, Trials is set in the late ‘50s, an era defined by Cold War paranoia. The game is set in the bowels of The Murkoff Corporation, a research firm tasked with creating sleeper cells.

With seemingly no limit on financing or bodies, the company is pushing the outer limits of narcotics and mind control. An elevated MK Ultra, Murkoff isn’t just designing the drugs a Charles Manson type might trip on; it’s drafting blueprints for its own BTK. Along with two or three friends, your compatibility will be tested in controlled environments, slaughterhouses recreating places of commerce, faith, bread and circuses. You will be asked to commit horrors. If you abstain, those horrors will be committed on you.

Recommended to me by author Grady Hendrix, Slob was published in the late ‘80s but soaked in the remnants of ’60s counterculture, a lurid paperback made layered by its government paranoia. Tales of supersoldier programs are not unique. Half of all genre fiction seems to be about them and about half of those posit these programs as a bad thing. What makes it more interesting is that it has the clarity to paint the bigger picture, the fortitude to name the national projects that such mad science benefits, on whose behalf, and at what cost. It’s those key similarities that made me feel like Trials is influenced by Miller’s admittedly obscure work, and that make me far more confident the game took beats from the more popular, non-fiction 2019 tome Chaos by Tom O’Neill with Dan Piepenbring, which attempts to chronicle how many of these programs were real all along .

There is not a subtle bone in The Outlast Trials’ body. Each environment is saturated with blood. Where the heaps of mannequin parts end and the mountains of eviscerated limbs begin is indistinguishable. It is, quite possibly, the gnarliest game ever made, a truly inspired feat in an experience that may lead to heated debates over which “execution” is the most depraved. Due to their pacing and agonizing presentation, tarring, feathering and castrating a man dressed like Donald Duck can be as stomach-turning as pulverizing a judge’s ankle bones with gavels. One trial implies that you, yes you, created the AIDS virus .

As you complete each trial, you must outmaneuver previous failed experiments whose augmentations, disfigurements, and madness make them incompatible with field work. You’re also being pursued by the “prime assets,” singular all-star murderers whose reputation and charisma caught the attention of the Murkoff Corporation. This includes an oedipal Miami gangster, a leather cop with a lightning fetish, and conjoined twins who, despite their impossible disfigurements, converse like guests on William F. Buckley’s Firing Line . They’re the Village People from hell. They are not just your enemies. They are enemies of life. Of dignity. Civil rights. Labor movements. Democracy. They are totems of empire enlisted on behalf of Murkoff, who are working on behalf of western interests.

In one of the game’s endings, you awaken in the Congo at the far end of a firing line, sitting on your knees. Your interrogators demand to know the significance of a string of words, unknowingly speaking out your trigger phase. When you come to a second time, bodies have piled up and your thumbs are submerged in a man’s eye sockets. Previous endings follow a similar structure. You awaken in a Cuban hotel room, caked in blood. You come to in China, having freshly produced sexual blackmail. In the Saigon ending, you’re behind the wheel of a car, barreling past a checkpoint with a bomb strapped to your chest, mirroring real embassy bombings throughout the early ’50s. How this prequel will ultimately tie in with the incidents at Mount Massive Asylum feels less significant than how it will tie in with a larger alternative history. If I’m allowed to trust my gut, I can think of one especially prominent political assassination that the game might be building up to.

This doesn’t make the connective tissue to the other Outlast s insignificant, but the greater weight is less on the details than the inevitable arc. The Outlast Trials is about a weapons factory. Vampires and werewolves made on assembly lines and shipped overseas to violate political movements the powers that be deem inconvenient. To uphold American might. But inevitably, the violence returns. It returns to Mount Massive. It returns in lost boys and biker gangs. In summers of serial killers. In political assassinations carried out by individuals with holistically unplaceable values. It comes from an indifference to life, echoed from the top, festering all the way down. From the promise of stability being replaced with casino games . It is honed violence, intentionally manufactured for one purpose, but spilling over into one’s backyard. It is a political project, but one that can only imagine itself on one end of the knife. And once it’s loose, look out behind you.

items.title: 'We act as if Halloween is ours': The best way to spend spooky season is within The Outlast Trials' Sinyala Facility
items.summary: What better way to celebrate Halloween than by giving yourself nightmares?
items.content:
Horror The Outlast Trials 'We act as if Halloween is ours': The best way to spend spooky season is within The Outlast Trials' Sinyala Facility Features By Elie Gould Published 30 October 2026 What better way to celebrate Halloween than by giving yourself nightmares?

(Image credit: Red Barrels) {alert('Link copied')}).catch(err => {console.error('Failed to copy: ', err)})" data-platform="copy_link" data-action="" class="font-ui-heading py-2 text-sm text-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-100 transition-colors no-underline block cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent w-full text-left normal-case" aria-label="Copy link" role="menuitem" data-analytics-id="article-social" analytics-label="utility-bar-social-share-copy-link" analytics-name="utility-bar-secondary" data-mrf-recirculation="article-social"> Copy link Facebook X Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter I like to manifest Halloween year-round, what with my favourite pastimes being horror games, movies, and books—oh, and Dressmaker currently. So when Halloween actually falls upon me I like to make it something special—crack out the real horrifying stuff that'll hit even harder. One series that's always on my list is Outlast thanks to its next-level gore and perfect scares, plus if I want to drag my friends into a shared nightmare there's The Outlast Trials for all to enjoy.

"Halloween has always been—even going back to the first Outlast—one of our biggest months, and it definitely kickstarts the biggest part of the year, which is October, November, and the holidays," Red Barrels co-founder Philippe Morin tells me. "Those are usually the best months of the year in terms of sales. We don't control what other studios do, obviously, but we act as if Halloween is ours."

This year Red Barrels decided to celebrate the spooky season with a huge sale to encourage new players to enter the Sinyala Facility and give The Outlast Trials a try over the spookiest month of the year. And it worked, way beyond what they'd hoped for: The game's concurrent player count on Steam ended up capping out at 147,955 players, a hugely impressive feat for a horror game that's over three years.

"We knew with that 90% sale we'd get a lot of new players, but we didn't expect that many," Morin says. "That first week of October was pretty insane. Every day I was waking up checking the numbers, thinking okay, that's probably going to be the top, and then it's gonna start to go down, but every day it kept going higher and higher.

"Obviously after the sale it trickled down a little bit, but hopefully it's gonna stabilise at a much higher level than what we had before. But yeah, it's pretty satisfying to see that after being out for more than three years, the game still finds a new audience. And it's very satisfying to watch all these people play the game and suffer."

The Outlast Trials is still the scariest multiplayer horror game there is. Usually adding other players to a horror game will dampen the experience, whether that be because it becomes simply too funny to jump at or things just aren't as scary when you have your friends by your side. And while I've certainly laughed in The Outlast Trials it's usually a frantic nervous laugh that's triggered when I see some naked goliath barrelling towards an unsuspecting teammate.

But experiencing collective trauma with your friends isn't the only reason to play The Outlast Trials over Halloween: there's also a new event. The whole gist of The Outlast Trials is that you and your mates are stuck in a Murkoff testing facility, the Sinyala Facility, where everyone is forced to undergo weird and painful experiments. The goal, naturally, is escape, which is usually impossible—but right now, in this new event, it's actually attainable.

So now's the time because it's not going to last forever. Murkoff is always watching."

items.title: New Update | Geister Limited-Time Event, Community Event, MK-Challenges & More
items.summary: Greetings Reagents Freedom is within reach... Or so we’re led to believe. The Season 7.2 Update for The Outlast Trials is live! Help Amelia in the ESCAPE THE FACILITY Community Event , return to the madness of the GEISTER Program , and take
items.content:
Greetings Reagents

Freedom is within reach... Or so we’re led to believe. The Season 7.2 Update for The Outlast Trials is live! Help Amelia in the ESCAPE THE FACILITY Community Event, return to the madness of the GEISTER Program, and take on two new MK-Challenges. Plus, test your limits with revamped Escalation Therapy, personalize your look with the new Favorites feature, and more.

This update includes 

  • Geister Limited-Time Event is back!

    [/*]

  • New Geister Catalog

    [/*]

  • Geister 2025 Catalog Available in Murkoff Store

    [/*]

  • New Community Event: ESCAPE THE FACILITY 

    [/*]

  • New MK-Challenge: COMPEL THE CHILDREN

    [/*]

  • New MK-Challenge: SANITIZE THE FACTORY

    [/*]

  • Escalation Therapy Changes

    [/*]

  • Favorites Feature

    [/*]

  • Black Market Sale

    [/*]

GEISTER Limited-Time Event

Program "Geister" is an experiment in convergent hallucinatory therapy designed to amplify unforeseen side effects of the Trials. 

Surviving subjects will learn to contribute to a morally hygienic Trial Environment through biohazard collection. Complete the secondary objective for extra rewards. 

Variators: 

  • HARVEST ORGAN SAMPLES - Find deceased reagents and harvest organ samples for analysis. 

    [/*]

  • HALLUCINATIONS? - Side effect, trauma or something else? 

    [/*]

  • MORE IMPOSTERS - More imposters in the Trial. 

    [/*]

GEISTER CATALOG

  • A brand new Catalog is available for the duration of the Limited-Time Event. 

    [/*]

  • Players can spend their acquired Event Tokens in the Catalog to unlock exclusive rewards. 

    [/*]

  • Once the event concludes, the Catalog will be removed and any unused Event Tokens will be forfeited. Be sure to spend your Event Tokens before the end of the event on December 8 at 10am ET.

    [/*]

New Community Event: ESCAPE THE FACILITY

"We need your help.

Find as much escape intel as possible, and make sure to leave the Trial with it. 

We need everyone onboard to make the escape possible this time. 

We're all getting out! - A”

Help Amelia! Reagents must find Escape Intel Schematics and leave the Trials with them in their inventory. Every phase of the Community Event unlocks exclusive rewards for participating Reagents. Reaching each milestone phase will get you one step closer to the possibility of Escape.

New MK-Challenge: COMPEL THE CHILDREN

You are the gentle prayer, the shame ingested and repeated until it feels like your own, and becomes a vector of further infection. Pray for the children, and we will let you out. 

This MK-Challenge will be featured in Phase 1 of the Geister Program and is avaialable in GENESIS.

New MK-Challenge: SANITIZE THE FACTORY

You are the rain, a drop in the flood that will nourish the earth, drown the wicked, and cleanse the filth. Sanitize the factory and we will let you out.

This MK-Challenge will be featured in Phase 2 of the Geister Program and is available in GENESIS.

Escalation Therapy Changes

  • Rebalanced the difficulty curve of Escalation Therapy for a smoother progression: 

    • Tier 1 (Trials #1–20): Build your character. 

      [/*]

    • Tier 2 (Trials #21–30): Put your character to the test. 

      [/*]

    • Tier 3 (Trials #31+): Enter the endgame. 

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Added a new permanent Variator starting at Trial #31: 

    • BREAKING POINT. A collection of punishing modifiers. Deadly enemies. Scarce resources. No second chances. Rigs don't recharge. And more. Push your mental and physical limits. 

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Revive Syringes and Revive Pills can now be acquired during Intermission item selection. 

    [/*]

  • Retouched several Escalation Therapy Tasks to better align with the new progression. 

    [/*]

Favorites Feature

You can now mark any customization item as a favorite. Use the Favorites filter in both your Cell Customization and Reagent Customization Menus to quickly find and equip your preferred items. Now you can easily assemble your preferred outfits for any occasion. 

Black Market Sale

The Murkoff Black Market is offering Reagents 50% off selected Legendary Outfits from now until November 3rd. Check out the in-game store to see if any behavioral attire catches your eye!

Additions/Fixes/Balancing 

  • The “Geister 2025” Catalog is now available for purchase in the Murkoff Store. 

    [/*]

  • Added new Weeklies to the Weekly Escalation pool. 

    [/*]

  • Reagent customization is now preserved after Relapses, except after the first Relapse. 

    [/*]

  • Lock Breaker Amp: Bricks now break instantly after unlocking a padlocked container or door. 

    [/*]

  • Reagents can now look behind them while assisting teammates in the Incapacitated or Dead state. 

    [/*]

  • Added a setting to enable or disable the new controller minigame feature. 

    [/*]

  • Trials adjustments: 

    • Fund the Campaign: Reworked the escape phase difficulty and exit timer based on objective completion. 

      [/*]

    • Eliminate the Past: Reworked the escape phase difficulty and exit timer based on objective completion. 

      [/*]

    • Battery Stations no longer count as light areas for player detection. 

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • Other general fixes and improvements. 

    [/*]

As always, we want to hear from you! Let us know what you think of The Outlast Trials through our feedback form. If you happen to encounter any issues while playing, please join our 18+ Official Outlast Discord Server and create a ticket to speak directly with our support team.

Remember, we are all getting better together, and we will see you in the Sleep Room, Reagents!

The RB Team

Remember that you can join our official 18+ Outlast Discord Server and open a '/ticket' to speak directly with our support team about any issues you encounter in-game. You can also fill out our General Feedback Survey here to let us know what you think about The Outlast Trials.

Catch you in the Sleep Room!

- The RB Team

items.title: Hotfix Patch Notes | Chemical Leak - Sept. 11

items.content:
Greetings Reagents,

We have released a new hotfix patch to address the following issues:

  • Escalation: Removed Permanent Damage and No Revive from the Ultra II variator in Escalation. We plan to revisit these modifiers later as part of a broader rebalance of the Escalation flow and difficulty curve.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the Kress Twins document could be acquired outside of the Fund the Campaign MK-Challenge.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where audio was missing from shuttle videos during shuttle sequences on console.

    [/*]

  • Fixed and issue where it was possible to get stuck in the main menu/loading screen.

    [/*]

  • Fixed input binding for players using AZERTY keyboards.

    [/*]

Feel free to join our official 18+ Outlast Discord Server and open a '/ticket' to speak directly with our support team about any issues you encounter in-game, and you can fill out our General Feedback Survey here.

We will see you in the Sleep Room! - The RB Team

items.title: New Update | Chemical Leak Limited-Time Event, 2 New MK-Challenges & more
items.summary: Greetings Reagents, Reagents, hold your breath! Murkoff is releasing toxic gas into the Trials with the new Chemical Leak Limited-Time Event , featuring a new exclusive Limited-Time Chemical Leak Catalog . This update also brings 2 new MK-C
items.content:
Greetings Reagents,

Reagents, hold your breath! Murkoff is releasing toxic gas into the Trials with the new Chemical Leak Limited-Time Event, featuring a new exclusive Limited-Time Chemical Leak Catalog. This update also brings 2 new MK-Challenges, a new round of improvements and balancing updates to Invasion and Escalation, along with new quality-of-life options and other changes to the Therapy experience. Let's see how well you endure the fumes and survive the Therapy!

This update includes

  • New Limited-Time Event: CHEMICAL LEAK

    [/*]

  • New Limited-Time Catalog: CHEMICAL LEAK

    [/*]

  • New MK-Challenge: CHANGE THE PROGRAM

    [/*]

  • New MK-Challenge: FUND THE CAMPAIGN

    [/*]

  • Various bug fixes and improvements.

    [/*]

New Limited-Time Event: CHEMICAL LEAK

Poison is an intoxicating embrace that suffocates the body, just as false idols poison the beliefs of the weak, uneducated, and vulnerable. Shut off the valves, breathe freely, and remember that therapy is the only answer.

Variators:

  • CHEMICAL LEAK -A chemical leak is filling the Trial with toxic gas. Find the valves to clear the gas from each area.

    [/*]

  • SHUT OFF THE VALVES - Shut off the valves in the Trial to stop the chemical leaks.

    [/*]

The event runs from Tuesday Sept. 8 (10AM ET) until Tuesday Oct. 6 (10AM ET).

New Limited-Time Catalog: CHEMICAL LEAK

  • A brand new Catalog is available for the duration of the Chemical Leak Limited-Time Event.

    [/*]

  • Players can spend their acquired Event Tokens in the Catalog to unlock exclusive rewards.

    [/*]

  • Once the Chemical Leak Event concludes, the Catalog will be removed and any unused Event Tokens will be forfeited. Be sure to spend your Event Tokens before the end of the event on Tuesday Oct. 6 (10AM ET).

    [/*]

New MK-Challenge: CHANGE THE PROGRAM

You are the crier, who knows that news does not have to be journalism, it only has to be new. Spread our truth, change the program, and we will let you out. 

New MK-Challenge: FUND THE CAMPAIGN

You are the hammer in the hands of a child, to shatter the fragile swine who would separate success from the government it created. Money is the future of speech. Fund the campaign and we will let you out.

Additions/Fixes/Balancing

Invasion

  • Evasive Manoeuvre: Now counters Backstabs by triggering a STRUGGLE instead, and win STRUGGLES more easily against Imposters.

    [/*]

  • Neuroshock: Now automatically pinged when thrown on the ground.

    [/*]

  • During the Exit Phase: When a Reagent is revived, an Imposter will spawn from a closet to match the new number of living Reagents.

    [/*]

  • Ex-Pops and Prime Assets will no longer target Reagents immediately after a Stab or Backstab.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where the Steel Trap deployment audio could be heard from a very long distance.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where players could body block other players (You can now push past a player of the opposing role who is blocking your path by walking into them for half a second.)

    [/*]

Escalation

  • Removed Broken Reagent from the variators pool.

    [/*]

  • Improved Escalation run stability to reduce server disconnections.

    [/*]

  • Players can now restore their save after a disconnection or crash.

    [/*]

  • Escalation Trial #21 and above: Damage is permanent throughout the run, and Revives are no longer available, making higher-level Trials even more challenging.

    [/*]

General

  • Improved online stability, including rubberbanding, lag, and disconnections. We will continue monitoring performance and making improvements as needed.

    [/*]

  • Player loadouts are now displayed in the Pause Menu.

    [/*]

  • Rebirth: Loadouts are no longer reset after completing a Rebirth.

    [/*]

  • Reworked Biter speed and aggressiveness, and slightly increased its chance of breaking the chain.

    [/*]

  • Slightly increased Kress Twins chase speed.

    [/*]

  • Slightly reduced Arora throw cooldown.

    [/*]

  • Fixed the price of the Jammer Rig skin in the Project Boneyard Catalog. It now costs 30 (was 75).

    [/*]

  • Fixed the rarity of the Project Boneyard poster. It is now Classified (was Basic).

    [/*]

  • Fixed the numbering of the Hopscotch floor game in the Orphanage, making it playable again.

    [/*]

  • Mods support is no longer available. While we recognize that mods can offer useful customization, some can provide gameplay advantages or alter the game in unintended ways. To maintain a fair and consistent experience for everyone across all game modes, mods are no longer supported.

    [/*]

  • We’ve added several new options to the Settings menu, including quality of life features that were previously available through mods. These are now built directly into the game and available to everyone:

    • Field of View — Slider

      [/*]

    • Camera Shake — Slider

      [/*]

    • Motion Blur — On / Off

      [/*]

    • Film Grain — On / Off

      [/*]

    • Chromatic Aberration — On / Off

      [/*]

    • Lens Flares — On / Off

      [/*]

    • Vignette — On / Off

      [/*]

    • Bloom — On / Off

      [/*]

    • Startup videos — On / Off

      [/*]

    • Toggle HUD Display — On / Off

      [/*]
    [/*]

We’d love to hear what other quality-of-life features you’d like to see added to the game. Please share your suggestions through our feedback form.

If you encounter any issues in-game, feel free to join our 18+ Official Outlast Discord Server and create a ticket to speak directly with our support team.

Catch you in the Sleep Room, Reagents!

The RB Team
